About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters
Join the Missionforce marketing team for a Summer 2027 internship, where you help bring Salesforce's AI-powered solutions to governments and national security organizations around the world. On the product marketing (PMM) team, you will partner with field marketing, content marketing, campaigns, and events, to bring to market Missionforce, Salesforce’s agentic government platform.
As an intern, you work alongside experienced marketers to support product and feature launches, such as webinars, email, virtual events, and digital campaigns. You use AI-powered tools to work faster and personalize outreach. Your work helps public sector leaders see how trusted, secure AI can support their mission, and it creates sales opportunities for our teams.
Core Responsibilities & Scope
Turn technical product details into clear, customer-focused stories, such as messaging, one-pagers, and talking points for public sector audiences.
Write and refine content that explains how Missionforce solutions help governments and national security organizations, including web copy, email, and launch materials.
Research customer needs, market trends, and competitors, using AI tools where they help, to shape how we position products.
Partner with product, field marketing, and sales teams to support product launches and campaigns, keeping projects organized and on schedule.
Build sales enablement materials, such as short presentations and guides, that help sales leaders explain product value with confidence.
Present your project and recommendations to marketing leaders and executives at the end of the internship.
Minimum Requirements
Rising Senior currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, communications, or a related field. Graduation Dates: Winter 2027 / Spring 2028
Strong passion for marketing and project management with a desire to gain practical experience in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proactive and self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Detail-oriented with a keen eye for accuracy.
Proficient in Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides).
Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., generative AI platforms, AI-assisted writing or analytics tools) and openness to incorporating them into daily work.
Knowledge of marketing principles and concepts.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
Familiarity with CRM or other enterprise software tools.
Interest in the Public Sector.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior internship experience in product marketing is a plus.
Ability to translate technical concepts into simple, mission-relevant stories
Experience using AI tools for content creation, data analysis, or campaign optimization is a bonus.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, solutions-oriented environment
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. postings.title: 2027 - AI and People Transformation Intern, NYC
postings.description:
We’re seeking AI & People Transformation Interns to help reimagine how our People teams work. You’ll examine how process design, data, and emerging AI tools can help simplify and improve everyday experiences for employees, managers, recruiters, and People team partners.
Based in our New York City office and working within the People PMO, you’ll partner with mentors, project leaders, People teams, and IT to map operational workflows, identify friction points and opportunities for AI or automation, and help assess or test practical solutions. We’re looking for interns who bring a fresh perspective, look for opportunities to rethink existing workflows, and connect ideas across projects. In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in business, management, operations, information systems, or business analytics; we welcome other backgrounds that demonstrate an interest in operational improvement.

postings.title: Software Engineer Intern (AI / ML) - Summer 2027
postings.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
SOFTWARE ENGINEER INTERN (AI / ML) - SUMMER 2027
Snowflake started with a clear vision: develop a cloud data platform that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Snowflake developed an innovative new product with a built-for-the-cloud architecture that combines the power of data warehousing, the flexibility of big data platforms, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of the cost of traditional solutions. We are now a world-class organization with offices in more than a dozen countries and serving many more.
Expanding on Snowflake's trust promise and with the explosion of language models, we will democratize the ability to easily glean insights from massive amounts of structured and unstructured data using AI and natural language, from running powerful batch analysis to accurately answering interactive questions about any type of data.
We're looking for dedicated students who share our passion for groundbreaking technology and want to create a lasting future for Snowflake and you.
WHAT WE OFFER:
- Paid, full-time internships in the heart of the software industry
- Exposure to a fast-paced, fun, and inclusive culture
- A chance to work with world-class experts on challenging projects
- Opportunity to provide meaningful contributions to a real system used by customers
- High level of access to supervisors (manager and mentor), detailed direction without micromanagement, feedback throughout your internship, and a final evaluation
- Stuff that matters: treated as a member of the Snowflake team, included in company meetings/activities, flexible hours, casual dress code, accommodations to work from home, swag, and much more
- Catered lunches, access to gaming consoles, recreational games, happy hours, company outings, and more
WHAT WE EXPECT:
- Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college/university program during the time of the internship
- Desired class level: Masters, or PhD
- Desired majors: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Math, or related field
- Recommended coursework: artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, federated learning, efficient LLMs, information retrieval, predictive & generative modeling, natural language processing, differential privacy, cloud computing, distributed & operating systems
- Research or publications in AI, ML, NLP, or CV or major contributions to open source
- Required to work onsite from designated office full time
- When: Summer 2027
- Eligible start date options: May 10, 2027; May 24, 2027, June 21, 2027
- Eligible end date options: July 30, 2027; August 13, 2027; August 27, 2027; September 10, 2027
- Duration: 12-16 weeks recommended, more than 16 weeks also encouraged (12 month maximum)
- Excellent programming skills in Python, Golang, and Java
- Preferred knowledge of PyTorch or CUDA
- Experience with working as a part of a team
- Dedication and passion for technology
WHAT YOU WILL LEARN/GAIN:
- Engineering for Scale: Learn to build highly integrated, secure, and scalable products that enable end-to-end ML workflows
- Agentic Workflows: Gain experience with agentic testing, iteration, and managing complex workflows for SQL generation
- Evaluation & Trust: Understand how to build evaluation loops to measure the groundedness, reliability, and safety of AI-powered features
- Multimodal Data Processing: Learn how to apply AI operations natively to both structured and unstructured data within a cloud database
- High-Performance Research: Gain exposure to hardware performance optimization to achieve better LLM throughput
POSSIBLE TEAMS/WORK FOCUS AREAS:
- Applied AI: Building production-grade AI systems (agents, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations) and deploying them with strategic customers
- ML Platform: Developing infrastructure for feature stores, MLOps, and highly optimized runtimes for both structured and unstructured data
- LLM Products & Snowflake Intelligence: Creating AI systems that reason over governed data and shipping features like design prompts and agent workflows
- AI Migrations (Agents for Code): Building intelligent agents to automate SQL code conversion and data migrations using Java, Go, and LangGraph
- Cortex Search, Analyst & Agents: Developing low-latency fuzzy search (Cortex Search), natural language interfaces for business questions (Cortex Analyst), and custom AI agents
- Cortex AI in SQL: Integrating generative AI directly into database queries to handle multimodal data natively
Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company's confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company's data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.
Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
How do you want to make your impact?
